name: NeO 360
aliases: Neural Fields for Sparse View Synthesis of Outdoor Scenes
definition: A generalizable extension to the NeRF approach for unbounded 360-degree scenes, using image-conditional tri-planar representations for few-shot novel view synthesis.
summary: NeO 360 is a zero-shot neural field method for few-shot novel view synthesis of unbounded outdoor scenes, distinguished by combining global tri-planar representations with local residual features and separate foreground-background MLPs.
